examples.arabic: لما وصلوا أصحابنا، كانوا مبسوطين كتير لما شافوا مائدة أكلنا، وقعدنا كلنا نتذوق كل لقمة بحب.
examples.english: When our friends arrived, they were very happy when they saw our feast table, and we all sat down to taste every bite with love.
examples.transliteration: Lamma waSal-u as'hab-na, kaan-u mabsooTein kteer lamma shaf-u ma'edet akl-na, w qa'ad-na kill-na netdhawwaq kill loqmeh b-hobb.
examples.storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

examples.arabic: بعد ما خلصت اكلت اول لقمة وكانت لذيذة كتير
examples.english: After I finished, I ate the first bite and it was very delicious.
examples.transliteration: Ba'ed ma khallaṣet akalt awwal loqme w-kanat ladheedha kteer.
